passages.note: Bill history page lists Hernandez A as Prime sponsor of HB2241, signed by the Governor 07/09/2021 as Chapter 418.

passages.provision_quote: the state board of education shall include a requirement that students be taught about the Holocaust and other genocides at least twice between the seventh and TWELFTH grades
passages.note: Operative text mandates a Holocaust/genocide instruction requirement, a named historical-injustice unit narrower than rung 2's full racism, injustice, and diverse-identities core curriculum (annex 'Broader than the instrument').
House Third Reading passed 59-0-0-0-1 with Hernandez A voting Y; a near-unanimous vote cannot alone carry a chair.

rows.reasoning: Hernandez prime-sponsored and voted for HB 2241 (2021), whose operative text requires that 'students be taught about the Holocaust and other genocides at least twice between the seventh and TWELFTH grades.' That is a named historical-injustice unit, narrower than 'Teach an honest account of racism, injustice, and diverse identities as part of the core curriculum,' which requires racism, injustice, and diverse identities together across the core curriculum, so the record shows only a direction toward that rung.
